column1: # Frequent pack words carrying a mark -- an apostrophe or a hyphen -- appended, prepended and
# wrapped, plus contractions whose mark was left out. Generated across the class rather than
# listed, so it covers hyphens as well as the apostrophes that were reported.
# Two expectations in one file, told apart by whether the mark is present in what was typed.
# A mark typed is deliberate and the text must survive intact -- `suggest_eval --autocorrect`
# should commit nothing. A mark omitted is a convention dropped and must still be restored:
# those rows name the contraction. See kMarkDeleteCost and kMarkInsertCost in engine.cpp.
